title: Cost of privacy
summary: Manage DUST and understand that protecting citizen privacy also requires efficiency and strategy decisions.
dramaticDescription: Everything has a cost. In a world where every protected piece of data requires resources, you must decide how much privacy you can afford to spend.
introScene: Your history is shielded. But the system presents you with a new metric: DUST. Each layer of privacy you add costs more. How much are you willing to pay to protect what you are?
